newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SAirGroup sets up taxes as group function.
newsitem.headline: SAirGroup sets up taxes as group function.

text.p: SAirGroup said it had set up the activity of taxes as a group function as part of its recent corporate restructuring.
The function will be headed by Andreas Simmen, 47, from July 1. He was previously with Zurich's Burkhardt Treuhand and has often advised SAirGroup in the past, SAirGroup said.
On August 1, Sten Daugaard, a 40-year-old Danish citizen, will take over the area of Treasury.
Daugaard is currently with ITT Industries Europe in Frankfurt and was previously active in the U.S. and Denmark.
